ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: They were sent to a new colony, or kept at the old one, against their wish. It fades after a season. With both colonies standing they may ask once to move to the one they wanted; letting them go ends the reason for it.
ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.act: Let it fade, or let them move

ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: Someone close to them lives at the other colony now. It fades after a season.
The new colony's first night, around one fire.
ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.keep: They started a new home together. It stays with them a few days.
